'''Shawnkyr Nuruodo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss officer/Legends|officer]] in [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx]] and a [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|Clawcraft]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]] in the [[Empire of the Hand]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I will stay, until Borleias falls. Then I will return home. But if I die here, I want you to promise to return in my place. If I stay here, I am delaying the execution of my duty. If I die, you must carry out my duty.|Shawnkyr Nuruodo, to Jagged Fel|<ref name="Enemy Lines II" />}}
Shawnkyr was born to the influential [[Nuruodo family]], and by the age of twelve standard years, she served as a [[First Lieutenant/Legends|First Lieutenant]] and a [[cadet commander]] at the [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy|military academy]] in the [[Rata Nebula/Legends|Rata Nebula]]. There, she first met the [[Human/Legends|Human]] trainee [[Jagged Fel]], two years her senior, and after repulsing a [[Battle of Rhigar|raid]] by the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]], she ceded leadership of the cadets to him.<ref name="RSBF" />

At some point in the next few years, Shawnkyr joined [[Spike Squadron (Empire of the Hand)|Spike Squadron]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]]<ref name="Dark Journey" /> By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], she was part of [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], she was Fel's [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] in the [[force Spike]], in which capacity she served under him at the [[Battle of Garqi]].<ref name="Enemy Lines II" /> In [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]],<ref name="Dark Journey Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]'' to [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].</ref> she was the only pilot to accompany him on his scouting mission to former [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] space. On [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], in spite of their orders not to get involved in the conflict, she assisted him in recruiting the unit of volunteer pilots that became [[Vanguard Squadron (Hapes)|Vanguard Squadron]].<ref name="Dark Journey" />

She led the Vanguards when Fel joined [[Twin Suns Squadron]] and served alongside [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] during the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleias]] leading up to the [[Operation Emperor's Spear]].<ref name="Enemy Lines II" /> It is not known whether she remained with the Vanguards when a full squadron of [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|Clawcraft]] arrived to serve alongside the New Republic, and after the [[Battle of Ebaq|major victory]] over the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] at [[Ebaq 9]]<ref name="Force Heretic I">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref> in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]],<ref name="Force Heretic I Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'' to [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].</ref> she returned to Chiss space to report on developments in the war.<ref name="Force Heretic I" /> She returned to the front line in the final stages of the war, however, and when the surviving Clawcraft of the Chiss squadron were amalgamated into Twin Suns Squadron, she flew as Twin Suns Four during the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]].<ref name="Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
A female Chiss, Shawnkyr Nuruodo had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="RSBF" /> pale blue skin,<ref name="Dark Journey" /> and a tall, muscular build,<ref name="RSBF" /> who, by 27 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]],<ref name="Dark Journey Date" /> stood almost half a head taller than her wingmate, Colonel Jagged Fel and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyp Durron]]. Common to her species, Shawnkyr had low view of non-Chiss individuals, viewing them as "lesser races."<ref name="Dark Journey" />

==Equipment==
As a [[Chiss officer/Legends|Chiss officer]] and [[TIE pilot]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]],<ref name="Enemy Lines II" /> Shawnkyr Nuruodo wore a black [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] that had [[Red Flame (symbol)|red piping]]<ref name="Unifying Force" /> representing the [[Red Flame]]&mdash;the essence of courage, cunning, and the ideal state of perfection that could be aspired to in the Chiss culture.<ref name="RSBF" /> She operated a [[Shawnkyr's clawcraft|''Nssis''-class Clawcraft]].<ref name="Dark Journey" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shawnkyr Nuruodo first appeared in the short story "[[Red Sky, Blue Flame]]," which was written by [[Elaine Cunningham]] and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 7|seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="RSBF" /> on [[October 16]], [[2001]].<ref name="Rd">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20011018.html|text=Live on the Fringe: ''Gamer'' # 7}}</ref> The uncertainty over Shawnkyr's age comes because of questions concerning the chronological placing of the short story, her earliest chronological appearance.<ref name="Birth year 1" /><ref name="Birth year 2" /> Also, her name does not correspond to the expected pattern of [[Chiss/Legends#Language and names|Chiss names]], probably because author Elaine Cunningham was not made aware of the precedent during the writing of the [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|''The New Jedi Order'']] novels.
